data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis 6/6): Resolve --key/--link race. Fire-and-forget creates race: event A with --key, event B with --link emitted ms later may race A's event-id-map.json write. AC must require: telemetry_emit_wrapper.emit_event() when --key present performs SYNCHRONOUS in-parent pre-registration via register_key(event_id, key) BEFORE Popen child spawn, AND passes --event-id <id> to child (new flag in telemetry_emit.py) so child reuses parent-generated id. RED test: emit review_finding with --key=k1 then immediately emit resolver_outcome with --link=k1; assert resolver_outcome envelope contains finding_event_id == k1's event_id.
